description: Get an executable MERX quote when resource, amount, fixed-grid duration and target_address are supplied. The response names the quoted provider. Without all four fields, returns raw provider observations labelled as non-executable analytics.

amount.description: Exact resource amount for an executable quote.

duration.description: Executable duration/filter in seconds on the fixed grid, from 2 minutes through 24 hours. Omit it to see every raw provider tier; raw analytics may include longer non-orderable observations.

resource.description: Filter by resource type. Omit for all.

target_address.description: TRON recipient address for an executable quote.

name: get_prices
